logo.notes: Negro (black), "sin com" — the default wordmark. Alternates: the 6 other horizontal color variants (Blanco is for dark/navy backgrounds only), then all 7 isotype color variants. See DESIGN.md §6 Logo system for the full 7-color horizontal + isotype families and construction rules.
logo.rule: The Capitalizarme mark is ALWAYS one of the preserved files in this section (assets/logo/), placed as an from the real file. Never render the brand name as styled text / a hand-set wordmark in any deliverable. No generated or hand-drawn logo substitutes. See DESIGN.md §6 Logo system and §9 Anti-patterns.

display.notes: Also self-hosted in fonts/ as a preserved brand asset — see fonts/manifest.json. colors_and_type.css loads this face from Google Fonts CDN only.

imagery.style: Photographic 3D-rendered mascot imagery centered on Capi, the orange bear in business-casual dress (navy vest, white shirt, maroon tie). Capi is the brand's entire expressive/warmth layer; UI chrome around it stays restrained, geometric, and pill-shaped. Imagery sits on flat white or pale-blue-tint surfaces — no gradients, no dark mode, no beige/cream washes (DESIGN.md §1, §6).
subjects: Capi in everyday business and life poses: on the phone, filing paperwork, searching, busy, thumbs up, riding a rocket, skateboarding, graduating, at the movies, multi-angle lineup
Real-estate investment moments: evaluating a property, receiving documents, using the app
Whole-scene mascot renders (capi-scene-01/02) for hero or empty-state warmth
imagery.treatment: Always used as a whole photographic image — never recolored, tinted, cropped, flattened, or vectorized. Placed as a full standalone image for warmth in empty states, hero moments, and step call-outs; pair text side-by-side, never on top. Default to the preserved assets/mascot/ set over generating new illustrated characters (DESIGN.md §6, §5 Don'ts).
avoid: Recoloring, cropping, or flattening the Capi mascot into a 2D icon
Placing UI text or labels on top of a Capi image
Hand-drawn illustration or generic stock photos in place of the preserved mascot renders
Gradients, dark surfaces, or beige/cream backgrounds behind imagery
Inventing illustrated characters instead of the real Capi asset
